*CRITICAL — block shipping*
• `src/schedule.js:6–7`: The renewal day is clamped against the *current* month’s length, then used in the *next* month. This skips renewals or shifts the anniversary:
  - Jan 31, 2026 → *Mar 3*, expected Feb 28.
  - Jan 31, 2028 → *Mar 2*, expected Feb 29.
  - Feb 28, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, expected Mar 31.
  *Recommended fix:* Clamp against the target month: `daysInMonth(year, month + 1)`. Add regression tests for short-month transitions, leap February, and restoration of the original anchor.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but an additional renewal-boundary sweep found 66 incorrect dates across 1,860 cases. The two tests in `test/schedule.test.js` don’t exercise unequal month lengths.

No other findings. Reviewed the full diff against `main` and all source files; no files changed.
